items.title: Australia and New Zealand Economics Analyst: NZ Election Preview: Too Close to Call
items.summary: New Zealand’s 7 November election appears too close to call. Our Monte Carlo simulations of recent polling lean slightly towards a Labour-led outcome, while prediction markets slightly favour a continuation of the current National-led government.
